# Market-data catalogue

Every market-data object in the samples, by kind. Trades link to them through their market-data fields (`discountCurve`, `fxVolSurface`, …), which is how F8 impact on a curve finds every trade valued with it.

## Interest rate curve (`ir-curve`)

Discounting (OIS), projection (IBOR/term RFR), government or basis curve for a currency.

`CRV` · 28 objects: `CRV-AUD-BASIS`, `CRV-AUD-GOVT`, `CRV-AUD-OIS`, `CRV-AUD-PROJ`, `CRV-CAD-BASIS`, `CRV-CAD-GOVT`, `CRV-CAD-OIS`, `CRV-CAD-PROJ`, `CRV-CHF-BASIS`, `CRV-CHF-GOVT`, `CRV-CHF-OIS`, `CRV-CHF-PROJ`, `CRV-EUR-BASIS`, `CRV-EUR-GOVT`, `CRV-EUR-OIS`, `CRV-EUR-PROJ`, `CRV-GBP-BASIS`, `CRV-GBP-GOVT`, `CRV-GBP-OIS`, `CRV-GBP-PROJ`, `CRV-JPY-BASIS`, `CRV-JPY-GOVT`, `CRV-JPY-OIS`, `CRV-JPY-PROJ`, `CRV-USD-BASIS`, `CRV-USD-GOVT`, `CRV-USD-OIS`, `CRV-USD-PROJ`

## Repo curve (`repo-curve`)

General-collateral or specials repo rates by term.

`REPO` · 7 objects: `REPO-AUD`, `REPO-CAD`, `REPO-CHF`, `REPO-EUR`, `REPO-GBP`, `REPO-JPY`, `REPO-USD`

## FX spot rate (`fx-spot`)

Spot rate for a currency pair with bid/ask.

`FX` · 12 objects: `FX-AUDUSD`, `FX-EURGBP`, `FX-EURJPY`, `FX-EURUSD`, `FX-GBPUSD`, `FX-USDBRL`, `FX-USDCAD`, `FX-USDCHF`, `FX-USDCNH`, `FX-USDINR`, `FX-USDJPY`, `FX-USDKRW`

## FX forward curve (`fx-forward-curve`)

Forward points by tenor for a pair.

`FXF` · 12 objects: `FXF-AUDUSD`, `FXF-EURGBP`, `FXF-EURJPY`, `FXF-EURUSD`, `FXF-GBPUSD`, `FXF-USDBRL`, `FXF-USDCAD`, `FXF-USDCHF`, `FXF-USDCNH`, `FXF-USDINR`, `FXF-USDJPY`, `FXF-USDKRW`

## FX volatility surface (`fx-vol-surface`)

Implied vols by expiry and delta (ATM, 25D RR/BF).

`FXV` · 12 objects: `FXV-AUDUSD`, `FXV-EURGBP`, `FXV-EURJPY`, `FXV-EURUSD`, `FXV-GBPUSD`, `FXV-USDBRL`, `FXV-USDCAD`, `FXV-USDCHF`, `FXV-USDCNH`, `FXV-USDINR`, `FXV-USDJPY`, `FXV-USDKRW`

## Swaption volatility cube (`ir-vol-cube`)

Normal (bp) swaption vols by expiry × tenor.

`IRV` · 7 objects: `IRV-AUD`, `IRV-CAD`, `IRV-CHF`, `IRV-EUR`, `IRV-GBP`, `IRV-JPY`, `IRV-USD`

## Cap/floor volatility surface (`cap-vol-surface`)

Cap vols by maturity and strike.

`CPV` · 7 objects: `CPV-AUD`, `CPV-CAD`, `CPV-CHF`, `CPV-EUR`, `CPV-GBP`, `CPV-JPY`, `CPV-USD`

## Equity (`equity`)

A listed stock: price, dividends, sector and identifiers.

`EQ` · 10 objects: `EQ-CSCA`, `EQ-GRNT`, `EQ-HLXP`, `EQ-KZNM`, `EQ-LUMN`, `EQ-MRDN`, `EQ-NVTK`, `EQ-ORBT`, `EQ-RHNB`, `EQ-SLRS`

## Equity index (`equity-index`)

Index level with its largest constituents.

`EQX` · 5 objects: `EQX-NDX`, `EQX-NKY`, `EQX-SPX`, `EQX-SX5E`, `EQX-UKX`

## Dividend curve (`dividend-curve`)

Expected dividends by year (implied from dividend futures and forwards).

`DIV` · 15 objects: `DIV-CSCA`, `DIV-GRNT`, `DIV-HLXP`, `DIV-KZNM`, `DIV-LUMN`, `DIV-MRDN`, `DIV-NDX`, `DIV-NKY`, `DIV-NVTK`, `DIV-ORBT`, `DIV-RHNB`, `DIV-SLRS`, `DIV-SPX`, `DIV-SX5E`, `DIV-UKX`

## Equity volatility surface (`equity-vol-surface`)

`EQV` · 15 objects: `EQV-CSCA`, `EQV-GRNT`, `EQV-HLXP`, `EQV-KZNM`, `EQV-LUMN`, `EQV-MRDN`, `EQV-NDX`, `EQV-NKY`, `EQV-NVTK`, `EQV-ORBT`, `EQV-RHNB`, `EQV-SLRS`, `EQV-SPX`, `EQV-SX5E`, `EQV-UKX`

## Credit curve (`credit-curve`)

CDS par spreads by tenor, recovery and implied default probabilities.

`CDS` · 16 objects: `CDS-BUND`, `CDS-CASCADIA`, `CDS-GILT`, `CDS-GRANITE`, `CDS-HALCYON`, `CDS-HELIX`, `CDS-JGB`, `CDS-KAIZEN`, `CDS-LUMEN`, `CDS-MERIDIAN`, `CDS-NOVATEK`, `CDS-ORBITAL`, `CDS-RHEINTAL`, `CDS-SOLARIS`, `CDS-UST`, `CDS-VERDANT`

## Inflation index (`inflation-index`)

Published CPI fixings (US CPI-U NSA, HICPxT, UK RPI…).

`INF` · 4 objects: `INF-HICPX`, `INF-JPCPI`, `INF-UKRPI`, `INF-USCPI`

## Inflation curve (`inflation-curve`)

Zero-coupon breakevens by tenor, with monthly seasonality.

`INFC` · 4 objects: `INFC-HICPX`, `INFC-JPCPI`, `INFC-UKRPI`, `INFC-USCPI`

## Commodity (`commodity`)

A traded commodity with its benchmark, unit and venue.

`CMD` · 8 objects: `CMD-BRENT`, `CMD-COPPER`, `CMD-CORN`, `CMD-GOLD`, `CMD-NG`, `CMD-SILVER`, `CMD-SOY`, `CMD-WTI`

## Commodity forward curve (`commodity-curve`)

Futures settlement prices by delivery month.

`CMDC` · 8 objects: `CMDC-BRENT`, `CMDC-COPPER`, `CMDC-CORN`, `CMDC-GOLD`, `CMDC-NG`, `CMDC-SILVER`, `CMDC-SOY`, `CMDC-WTI`

## Commodity volatility surface (`commodity-vol-surface`)

Implied vols by delivery month and moneyness.

`CMDV` · 8 objects: `CMDV-BRENT`, `CMDV-COPPER`, `CMDV-CORN`, `CMDV-GOLD`, `CMDV-NG`, `CMDV-SILVER`, `CMDV-SOY`, `CMDV-WTI`

## Rate index fixings (`rate-fixing`)

Published overnight and term rate fixings (SOFR, €STR, SONIA…).

`FIX` · 7 objects: `FIX-AONIA`, `FIX-CORRA`, `FIX-ESTR`, `FIX-SARON`, `FIX-SOFR`, `FIX-SONIA`, `FIX-TONA`

`BND` · 32 objects: `BND-BRVERD054608`, `BND-BRVERD178449`, `BND-CACASC059511`, `BND-CACASC169344`, `BND-CHLUME076897`, `BND-CHLUME169114`, `BND-DEBUND064772`, `BND-DEBUND130144`, `BND-DERHEI090723`, `BND-DERHEI122872`, `BND-FRORBI079012`, `BND-FRORBI162925`, `BND-GBGILT065113`, `BND-GBGILT120223`, `BND-GBGRAN031444`, `BND-GBGRAN185331`, `BND-JP0JGB019237`, `BND-JP0JGB182753`, `BND-JPKAIZ021595`, `BND-JPKAIZ129190`, `BND-US0UST030079`, `BND-US0UST151040`, `BND-USHELI055667`, `BND-USHELI160541`, `BND-USMERI070218`, `BND-USMERI186295`, `BND-USNOVA065142`, `BND-USNOVA133999`, `BND-USSOLA031372`, `BND-USSOLA119789`, `BND-XSHALC061217`, `BND-XSHALC114008`

## Correlation matrix (`correlation-matrix`)

Pairwise correlations used by basket, quanto and spread products.

`CORR` · 3 objects: `CORR-EU-EQ`, `CORR-G10FX`, `CORR-US-EQ`

## How products select market data

| Trade field | Kind | Selected by |
|---|---|---|
| `basisCurve` | `ir-curve` | `basis:{ccy}` |
| `benchmarkCurve` | `ir-curve` | `govt:{ccy}` |
| `capVolSurface` | `cap-vol-surface` | `cap:{ccy}` |
| `commodityCurve` | `commodity-curve` | `{commodity}` |
| `commodityVolSurface` | `commodity-vol-surface` | `{commodity}` |
| `correlation` | `correlation-matrix` | `{corr}` |
| `creditCurve` | `credit-curve` | `{issuer}` |
| `discountCurve` | `ir-curve` | `ois:{ccy}` |
| `dividendCurve` | `dividend-curve` | `{equity}` |
| `equityVolSurface` | `equity-vol-surface` | `{equity}` |
| `equityVolSurface` | `equity-vol-surface` | `{index}` |
| `fixingIndex` | `rate-fixing` | `rfr:{ccy}` |
| `forwardCurve` | `ir-curve` | `proj:{ccy}` |
| `fxForwardCurve` | `fx-forward-curve` | `{pair}` |
| `fxSpot` | `fx-spot` | `{pair}` |
| `fxVolSurface` | `fx-vol-surface` | `{pair}` |
| `inflationCurve` | `inflation-curve` | `{infl}` |
| `inflationIndex` | `inflation-index` | `{infl}` |
| `repoCurve` | `repo-curve` | `{ccy}` |
| `swaptionVolCube` | `ir-vol-cube` | `swaption:{ccy}` |
| `underlyingBond` | `bond` | `{bond}` |
| `underlyingEquity` | `equity` | `{equity}` |
| `underlyingIndex` | `equity-index` | `{index}` |
